# Update IQ

Refresh an existing Customer IQ output when customer context changes.

## Inputs

- customer name
- current context file
- current Customer IQ output, if present
- any delta summary or recent change log entries

## Task

Update only what changed while preserving the standard Customer IQ section structure.

## Focus

- refresh outdated statements
- strengthen or remove unsupported opportunities
- update risks based on newly available evidence
- revise next actions to reflect the latest customer state

## Rules

- do not regenerate unsupported claims
- preserve grounded facts
- call out when the new evidence is still insufficient
- keep the result concise and actionable
